name: Phil Carrizzi
question: name changed / still in job / alive
finding: Name changed to Phillip Renato (formerly Carrizzi). Alive/active. Now Professor at Kendall College of Art and Design (Ferris State); founding chair of the Allesee Metals/Jewelry Design program (now under Product Design). MFA Univ. of Washington matches archive.

name: Stanley Lechtzin
question: still in job / alive / name changed
